page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head above the text, page number at the top right. Signature "C 3" at the lower left and catchword "ribus," at the lower right. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: trudi patiatur,quos multos quidem quarti sæculi Christianos in Ecclesia Græca velut spurios & suppositicios abjecisse constat ; ullos pro veris habuisse non constat ? Epiphanium quidem eos tribus quatuor locis usurpasse concedo ; eo fieri, ut pro vere Apostolicis habuerit, nego. Hoc quidem contra Audianos loco, qui omnium est luculentissimus, Constitutionum opus negat esse ἀδόκιμον, reprobum, sive reprobatum, hoc est, ut ego quidem interpretor, publico Ecclesiæ decreto rejectum & explosum. Laudat item, quod in eo continereıur omnis ordo canonicus, nihil inesset vel à fide vel à disciplina Ecclesiæ alienum.

At non ideo fit, ut libros à Clemente vere scriptos, vereque ab Apostolis institituta dictataque, quæcunque in illis narrantur, fuisse crediderit. Multis enim libris nihil inest vel à fide, vel à disciplina Ecclesiæ alienum, quos non idcirco dixeris vel Clementinos, vel Apostolicos. Omnino videtur Epiphanius sensisse, illas Apostolorum nomine tum vulgatas Diataxes boni & Catholici viri opus esse non inutile ; iisque sincere explicatam esse Ecclesiæ fidem, ac disciplinam ; Ut à Clemente scriptas, & ab ipsis Apostolis dictatas crediderit, nihil sane cogit. Contrarium suadet, quod idem alibi de hujus, quem citaverat, libri authoribus,

page.notes: The running head is "APOSTOL. LIB. I." and the page number is 37. The signature is "C 3" and the catchword "ribus," stands at the lower right. Some letters are blurred ("continereıur" is read as "contineretur"; "suppositicios" is read as printed "suppositicios" and may be "supposititicios"). The Greek word "ἀδόκιμον" is set as printed and is not fully certain. The last line is cut off at "autho-" and continues in the catchword.
